source_note: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别
english_source_note: Riemann Integral and Criteria for Integrability
callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#7
english_title: Theorem 2.1.2: Squeeze Theorem for Riemann Integrability
statement_en: A function $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$ is Riemann integrable if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exist two Riemann integrable functions $\alpha_{\varepsilon},\beta_{\varepsilon}$ such that $$\alpha_{\varepsilon}\leq f\leq \beta_{\varepsilon}$$ and $$\left|\int_a^b \alpha_{\varepsilon}(x)-\beta_{\varepsilon}\,dx\right|<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: approximation by integrable upper and lower functions
prerequisites: basic properties of the Riemann integral
callout_body: 函数$f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$黎曼可积，当且仅当对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在两个黎曼可积函数$\alpha_{\varepsilon},\beta_{\varepsilon}$满足$$\alpha_{\varepsilon}\leq f\leq \beta_{\varepsilon}$$并且$$\left|\int_a^b \alpha_{\varepsilon}(x)-\beta_{\varepsilon}\,dx\right|<\varepsilon$$
